lessons: This person follows through best at midday (12:00-14:00) and in afternoons, especially with psychological capability and physical opportunity; mornings, outdoor-context and late-evening slots are skipped or postponed more often. Heavy days are not a problem. Intensity 1 tasks are done reliably, higher intensity less so, so I keep the cardio at midday/early afternoon and cluster tasks in lunch windows on weekdays, avoiding weekends.
